negative_findings.description: Searched in Hungarian for a standalone MNB cash report ('Készpénzjelentés' / 'készpénz jelentés') analogous to the Payment Systems Report.
negative_findings.result_summary: No standalone recurring MNB cash report surfaced. Cash statistics appear distributed across the bankjegy-és-érme web pages, the monthly MNB balance-sheet release (currency in circulation), the Annual Report cash chapter, and occasional MNB-szemle studies.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must assemble the HU cash picture from several releases rather than tracking one report; assuming a single cash report would create a coverage hole.

negative_findings.description: The English legacy path www.mnb.hu/en/statistics/statistical-data-and-information/statistical-time-series/xiv-payment-systems/payment-data (surfaced by search) was fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: Returned HTTP 404. Content appears to have migrated to the statisztika.mnb.hu portal (statistical-topics/payment-systems). Recorded as unverified/likely-moved, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Old mnb.hu/en statistics deep links are stale across search indexes; the collector should canonicalise to statisztika.mnb.hu and treat legacy mnb.hu/en/statistics paths as redirects to resolve.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to identify stable direct xlsx/csv download URLs for the quarterly payment time series from the release pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Release pages describe downloadable time series and press releases but the rendered markdown did not expose stable file URLs; assets are likely served via dynamic /sw/static/file/ style paths or JS-rendered lists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collector will need a rendering-capable fetch (or link-pattern discovery on /sw/static/file/) rather than static link scraping to obtain the workbooks.

negative_findings.description: Looked for an MNB open-data API or bulk endpoint for payment/cash statistics.
negative_findings.result_summary: No MNB statistics API was identified in this pass; MNB publishes via web pages, Excel time series and PDFs. (MNB does expose an exchange-rate web service, which is out of scope for this cell.)
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Machine-readable acquisition for HU payment data likely has to go through the ECB Data Portal SDMX API, with MNB files as the authoritative but manual-format source.

brief: The MNB source landscape for Hungarian payment, card, ATM/POS and cash statistics is bifurcated between two hosts: statisztika.mnb.hu carries the machine-oriented statistical releases (the quarterly 'Tájékoztató - Pénzforgalom' with cards/ATM/POS/accounts/fraud/revenues, the VIBER-BKR-KELER settlement release, the monthly balance-sheet release holding currency in circulation, plus calendar, methodology and glossary), while www.mnb.hu carries the analytical and narrative layer (Fizetési rendszer jelentés / Payment Systems Report, Pénzforgalom 2030, MNB-tanulmányok and MNB-szemle, the bankjegy-és-érme cash pages, the Annual Report and the year-indexed press releases). Both HU and EN editions exist for the flagship report and the payments release, but legacy mnb.hu/en/statistics deep links are stale (404 observed) and should be canonicalised to statisztika.mnb.hu. No MNB open API for these series was found, so file-level acquisition will need rendering-capable fetching of the release pages, with the ECB Data Portal PTT dataset as the structured, API-accessible mirror of the same MNB-reported figures. Highest-value tracking targets are the quarterly payments release, the annual Payment Systems Report, the monthly currency-in-circulation series, and the 2001-2013 archive for long-run back-series.
